name: youtrack
label: YouTrack
description: JetBrains project management and issue tracking for agile teams.

baseUrl.label: Instance URL
baseUrl.description: Your YouTrack URL (e.g. https://example.youtrack.cloud). Do NOT include /api. The host only, without https://, such as name.example.com.

apiToken.label: Permanent Token
apiToken.description: From Profile -> Authentication -> Permanent Tokens. Starts with "perm:".

add_tag_to_issue.label: Add Tag to Issue
add_tag_to_issue.description: Adds an existing tag to an issue.

issue.label: Issue
issue.description: Select the issue to work with.

tag.label: Tag
tag.description: Select a tag to apply to the issue.

create_tag.label: Create Tag
create_tag.description: Creates a new tag in YouTrack.

list_tags.label: List Tags
list_tags.description: Lists all tags visible to the current user.

query.label: Filter by Name
query.description: Filter tags by name. Leave empty for all.

list_comments.label: List Comments
list_comments.description: Lists all comments on an issue with author details and timestamps.

issue.label: Issue
issue.description: Select the issue to work with.

add_user_to_team.label: Add User to Project Team
add_user_to_team.description: Adds a user as a direct member of a project team, giving them access to the project.

project.label: Project
project.description: Select the YouTrack project to work with.

list_attachments.label: List Attachments
list_attachments.description: Lists all attachments on a specific issue with metadata (name, size, type).

issue.label: Issue
issue.description: Select the issue to work with.
